test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
A cube is made by folding the given sheet. In the cube so formed, which number / letter will be on the face opposite to the face showing '7'?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0c3444f05bae44146caf83cb8e8ecbff8cad36e5af691575986f4b90a545807.png]
solution:
From the given open Dice:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c7b84adde01a5ac0757913c6522357f1cc7aa1aefe806d6db2cc5dd17ee949f.png] 

6 and A is the opposite sides.

8 and 9 is the opposite sides.

7 and 4 is the opposite sides.

So, the face of '4' is opposite to the face showing '7'

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
